box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

div.div:
Pixel matrix;
In C or C++ it can be declared as:
Pixel matrix[row][column];
In C++ a dynamic matrix can be done with std::vector:
std::vector<std::vector<Pixel>> matrix; or
In the infocell world there is no vector, only list or maps.
Actually an infocell is already a map like datastructure, so we emulating the 2d array with
std::Map<keyType=Number, valueType=std::Map<keyType=Number, valueType=GridItem>>
std::Map here is an infocell datastructure
